title: Vanilla and Chocolate Delight
description: Sweet cream cheese and chocolate-vanilla pudding are layered on a nutty pecan crust for a delightful dessert. Garnish with crumbled chocolate… Yum!
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed, divided
1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (3.4 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
2 (1.45 ounce) bars milk chocolate with crispy rice, crumbled

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). In a medium mixing bowl, combine pecans, flour, and butter. Press into a 9x13-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Allow to cool.
In a large bowl, beat together cream cheese and confectioners’ sugar until smooth. Fold in 1/2 of the whipped topping. Spread on top of cooled crust.

In a large bowl, combine milk, chocolate pudding mix, and vanilla pudding mix. Beat until thick. Pour over cream cheese layer. Top with remaining whipped topping, and sprinkle with crushed chocolate bars.
